entries.content_osis: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7146"/><div sID="gen10956" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7146"/>7-10. The call on the earth, as opposed to heaven, includes seas or depths, whose inhabitants the dragon, as one of the largest (on leviathan, see on <reference osisRef="Ps.104.26">Psa 104:26</reference>), is selected to represent. The most destructive and ungovernable agents of inanimate nature are introduced. <div eID="gen10956" type="x-p"/>

They are further described as "His people," and "near unto Him," sustaining by covenanted care a peculiarly intimate relation. <chapter eID="Ps.148"/>
entries.content_plain: 14. exalteth the horn-- established power ( Psa 75:5 , 6 ). praise of-- or literally, "for" his saints-- that is, occasions for them to praise Him. They are further described as "His people," and "near unto Him," sustaining by covenanted care a peculiarly intimate relation.
entries.reader_content_plain: 14. exalteth the horn-- established power ( Psa 75:5 , 6 ). praise of-- or literally, "for" his saints-- that is, occasions for them to praise Him.
